name: Elder Primadon, The Titan Warlord
desc:
Elder Primadon, the Titan Warlord is a stronger version of [Primadon](entity:elder_primadon_the_titan_warlord), with a larger body, darker skin tone, and glowing eyes.

Similar to [Primadon](entity:elder_primadon_the_titan_warlord), the Elder can be summoned by making an offering, however this variant of the beast only takes Sinner's Ash as an adequate offering. Elder Primadon will despawn after 23 minutes.
additional_info: -   Elder Primadon is the only feature to not appear in private servers. This is because it prevents outside parties ganking for the loot.
